shots.name: demo-output
shots.caption: examples/demo.py: three events reach a stand-in trace server, then each opt-out yields a client that sends nothing.
shots.alt: Terminal output of python examples/demo.py: the stand-in server receives three POST /api/metrics events with a Bearer key, the trace-client-python User-Agent, and version and install tags on every event; then DO_NOT_TRACK=1, enabled="false" and an empty key each give enabled=False with disabled_reason environment, config and no key.
